run_StableDiffusionXLControlNetInpaintPi: run the StableDiffusionXLControlNetInpaintPipeline to inpaint an image using a ControlNet model with a text prompt and mask
build_StableDiffusionXLControlNetInpaint: build a StableDiffusionXLControlNetInpaintPipeline from pretrained SDXL and ControlNet checkpoints for guided inpainting
encode_prompt_encode_prompt: encode a text prompt into CLIP text embeddings using the encode_prompt method for SDXL inpainting
prepare_latents_prepare_latents: prepare initial latents for inpainting by combining the init image with noise based on the strength parameter
prepare_mask_latents_prepare_mask_latent: prepare mask latents and masked image latents by resizing and encoding the mask for the inpainting UNet
